items.title: Introducing enhanced infrastructure observability in Amazon SageMaker HyperPod
items.summary: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now offers enhanced observability to help you diagnose GPU training issues faster. It brings together diagnostic and profiling capabilities for training workloads on both Amazon EKS and Slurm orchestrators, pinpointing issues across GPU, network, and host layers.
items.creator: Mijanur Palash

items.title: Using NVIDIA Run:ai GPU Fractioning on Amazon EKS
items.summary: Learn how to run two memory-bounded Kubernetes Pods on a single NVIDIA A10G GPU using open-source NVIDIA Run:ai GPU Fractioning on Amazon EKS. This walkthrough builds a custom Amazon Linux 2023 image, installs KAI Scheduler and the GPU Fractioning Operator, and validates per-Pod GPU-memory contracts with enforcement and metrics.
items.creator: Muru Bhaskaran
